subject.title: Gateway: account-scoped channel config changes restart the entire channel and can disrupt active traffic

question: Should OpenClaw accept generic account-scoped channel reload planning for `channels.<channel>.accounts.<accountId>.*`, and should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99312 become the canonical landing path over the older conflicting PR?
rationale: Source inspection confirms the bug, but the fix defines a gateway/channel lifecycle contract that affects bundled and external channel plugins, and two open PRs overlap.

options.title: Use the newer generic PR
options.body: Review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99312 as the canonical account-scoped reload implementation and close or supersede the older conflicting PR after a decision.

options.title: Revive the original PR
options.body: Ask the original PR author to resolve conflicts and supply real behavior proof if maintainers prefer that narrower branch.

options.title: Reject account-scoped reloads
options.body: Document whole-channel restarts as the intended contract and close the open implementation PRs with an alternative for reload disruption.

recommendation.title: Use the newer generic PR
recommendation.body: Review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99312 as the canonical account-scoped reload implementation and close or supersede the older conflicting PR after a decision.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has the strongest current file-history signal on the implicated gateway reload and channel lifecycle files.
